entry.title: Tidal Verb 1.6.0
entry.summary: tereo reverb with ten types (Room to Abyss and a cascading-octave Cascade shimmer), plus Swirl, Warmth and Air controls. For MPC OS 3.10.1+ (Akai Force, MPC Live/One/X/Key, MPC XL, Live III). **Install** 1. Preferences > Enhancements (Beta): turn on Enable Enhancements and External Plugin Support. 2. entry.title: Tidal Verb 1.0.0
entry.summary: Stereo reverb with ten types (Room to Abyss and a cascading-octave Cascade shimmer), plus Swirl, Warmth and Air controls. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.
